summary: The candidate adds test-only coverage for a DSpark TP synchronization mechanism already present in the recorded base. Its regression passes unchanged on that base and does not reproduce or execute the original unequal-row VocabParallelEmbedding collective. The pre-existing synchronization is a plausible partial mitigation relative to v0.5.18, but the candidate's full-fix/verification claim is unsupported by the available evidence.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's exact five tests passed on the unmodified recorded base, demonstrating that the candidate is not failing-before/passing-after and makes no runtime behavioral change.
Five candidate unit checks passed, using a local fake TP broadcast; this did not execute multi-rank RCCL/NCCL or unequal collective shapes.

tests.what_was_measured: Imports resolved to checkout source; default and rng presets include DSPARK_TARGET; off excludes it; one gfx950 device-tensor overwrite produced [17, 23, 42].
The candidate diff has no whitespace errors and changes only reports plus one Python test file.

gpu_execution.evidence: A same-device tensor overwrite and the candidate CUDA-like parameter ran on one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950. No real multi-rank collective was executed.

remaining_counterexamples: The candidate never constructs ranks with the original unequal embedding row counts (628 versus 1140 or 6098 versus 9682), so the reported collective contract is not reproduced.
SGLANG_SPEC_TP_SYNC=off disables the asserted protection; the candidate does not test detection or safe failure when TP state has already diverged.
The fake broadcast only copies same-shaped tensors locally and cannot expose distributed ordering, shape, process-group, or NCCL/RCCL failures.
Other DSpark or scheduler transitions can still theoretically diverge batch membership or sequence lengths; the AST test covers only one target-prefill call site.
No evidence connects the two recorded production sequence numbers to rank-local sampling divergence rather than another upstream scheduler/multimodal state divergence.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was available, not eight NVIDIA B300 GPUs.
Kimi-K3 and DSpark weights were unavailable.
CUDA 13.0 and NCCL 2.28.3 were unavailable; the environment used ROCm 7.2 and PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2.
Full-model TP=8 multimodal chunked prefill, sustained traffic, semantic accuracy, and watchdog behavior remain unverified.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
